scope: Open configuration and owner-decision items only. A completion path is not evidence that a system is configured or operational.

items.item: Select and configure the approved secret manager; record secret names and access policy, never secret values.

Inventory the required tool accounts and owner-selected plans, without guessing plan limits or costs.
Confirm the meaning and intended use of the recorded term "posilki".

Owner-authorize and configure the ChatGPT workspace.

Configure CapCut access and a reviewed edit/export path.
Document approved stock image/video sources and item-level rights evidence.
Document approved music/audio sources and item-level rights evidence.

Configure a human-approved scheduling workflow and its rollback path.
Configure analytics access, retention and owner review.
